factions.name: Clan
factions.description: The largest and most common race trait, covering core Clash Royale troops like Barbarians and Wizards; no unique numeric bonus but the default tag most minis carry.

factions.name: Goblin
factions.description: Sneaky green raiders; fielding multiple Goblin-class minis grants the team a chance to dodge/become immune to incoming attacks.

factions.name: Undead
factions.description: Skeletons and the risen dead; fielding Undead minis (e.g. via Witch) adds bonus damage dealt to the enemy Hero for a duration.

factions.name: Ranger
factions.description: Ranged marksmen such as Musketeer and Dart Goblin, built around sustained ranged damage output.

factions.name: Rogue
factions.description: Stealthy single-target strikers like the Miner; the Rogue class bonus gives a chance for Rogues to deal bonus damage.

factions.name: Specialist
factions.description: Utility/control-resistant minis; the Specialist class bonus periodically clears control effects (stun/freeze) from Specialist minis.

factions.name: Royal
factions.description: Nobles and the royal guard (Knight, Prince, Mega Knight); tanky and elite frontline units tied to the crown.

factions.name: Saint
factions.description: Healers and support casters such as Battle Healer and Healing Ranger, marked by a four-pointed star emblem.

factions.name: Mage
factions.description: Spellcasters like Wizard and Electro Wizard; the Mage class bonus increases damage dealt by Mage-class minis.

factions.name: Sea
factions.description: Naval/pirate-themed race trait; grants a team synergy bonus when multiple Sea-class minis are deployed together.

factions.name: Rider
factions.description: Mounted troops such as Hog Rider and Prince; the Rider class bonus increases damage dealt by Rider ability effects.

factions.name: Elixir
factions.description: Resource-focused minis; fielding an Elixir-class mini (e.g. Lumberjack) grants extra free Elixir generation each round.

cards.name: Barbarian
abilities: Attack speed increases the more HP he has lost
cards.description: Cheap melee brawler used to activate class bonuses and to fuel synergy with cards like Battle Healer.

cards.name: Knight
abilities: Taunts enemies in a 3x4 area in front of him for 3 seconds at the start of each round
cards.description: Frontline tank meant to soak damage in the front row and protect higher-value minis behind him.

cards.name: Miner
abilities: Burrows underground and resurfaces on the last tile of his lane
Attacks hit a 1x3 row
+30% attack and move speed with no allies directly adjacent
Removes 2 Energy from enemies hit with Super abilities ready
cards.description: Solo-lane infiltrator who tunnels past the front line to strike from the back row.

cards.name: Wizard
abilities: Super: fireball deals 8 damage to the closest enemy and any enemy in a 3x3 square around the target
cards.description: Classic area-damage caster that powers Mage-class synergy teams.

cards.name: Valkyrie
abilities: Deals damage to units in a 3x3 square around her target
cards.description: Spinning melee brawler that hits her main target plus every enemy in adjacent tiles.

cards.name: Witch
abilities: Super: spawns 2 Skeletons next to her
cards.description: Undead-synergy caster who reinforces the board with summoned Skeletons.

cards.name: Giant Skeleton
abilities: On death, drops a bomb dealing 12 damage in a 3x3 square after a 2-second delay and stuns enemies hit for 1 second
cards.description: Slow bruiser whose death leaves a delayed area-damage bomb behind.

cards.name: Musketeer
abilities: Super: fires a shell dealing 5 damage to the closest enemy, knocking it back 2 tiles and stunning it for 1.5 seconds
cards.description: Reliable backline ranged attacker used in Royal and Ranger synergy compositions.

cards.name: Hog Rider
abilities: Jumps 4 tiles forward at the start of each round, dealing 4 damage in a plus formation and stunning enemies hit for 2 seconds
cards.description: Fast mounted skirmisher that opens rounds by leaping past the front line into the enemy formation.

cards.name: Dart Goblin
abilities: Deals double damage for 6 seconds after defeating an enemy
Deals quadruple damage to enemies with Block or Shield
Each attack increases his attack speed by 12%, stacking infinitely
cards.description: Snowballing ranged goblin that gets faster and hits harder the longer a fight drags on.

cards.name: P.E.K.K.A
abilities: Attacks are guaranteed to deal double damage
Immune to control effects for 10 seconds
cards.description: Heavy-hitting armored melee unit built around massive single-target burst damage.

cards.name: Mega Knight
abilities: Super: jumps up then slams down, dealing 2 damage and stunning enemies for 2 seconds in a diamond formation
cards.description: Very high-HP jumping bruiser that crashes into the enemy formation to stun a wide area.

cards.name: Prince
abilities: Charges forward at the start of each round, dealing 8 damage, pushing back 3 tiles, and stunning for 3 seconds
cards.description: Lance-charging cavalry mini that opens each round with a disruptive dash attack.

cards.name: Electro Wizard
abilities: Super: deals 4 damage to the 3 closest enemies and stuns them for 2 seconds
Gives 2 Energy to allies directly beside him at the start of each round
cards.description: Low-HP ranged caster who both chain-stuns enemies and accelerates his allies' Super abilities.

cards.name: Battle Healer
abilities: Super: heals herself for 20% max HP, also healing allies within 2 tiles in a diamond formation
cards.description: Support mini that sustains the team through periodic area healing.

cards.name: Barbarian King
abilities: Super 'Iron Fist': deals double damage, affecting nearby allies
Promotion abilities heal a portion of his HP and extend an invincibility window
cards.description: The starter Hero, unlocked for every new player; a durable melee anchor for Clan-focused teams.

cards.name: Archer Queen
abilities: Ability heals herself and benefits nearby allies
cards.description: Ranged Hero with the lowest HP of all Heroes when promoted, valued for her self-sustain and support ability.

cards.name: Skeleton King
abilities: Super deals 12 damage to surrounding enemies, pushes them back 1 tile, and stuns for 2 seconds
Revives after death with 40% of his maximum HP
Deals 4 bonus damage to targets with no allies adjacent to them
cards.description: Undead-class Hero who can shrug off a first death and return to the fight at reduced HP.

cards.name: Royal Champion
abilities: Throws a shield dealing 12 damage and stunning her target for 0.5 seconds, hitting up to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles
cards.description: Long-ranged Royal-class Hero best kept in the back rows while tankier minis hold the front line.

cards.name: Monk
abilities: Palm strike deals 100 damage to his target
Heals himself for 10 and gains 4 Energy on defeating an enemy
Super 'Peace Maker' pierces through multiple enemies for a higher Energy cost
cards.description: High-HP, low-basic-damage melee Hero whose real threat comes from his devastating Super ability.
